tests.title: An owner's push of an existing branch to a local bare origin answers 200 with branch, sha, remote, remote_url and result
given: an active, ready standard workspace whose trunk has branch fix with one commit
origin is a local bare repository set as git_url
the caller is the owner using an API key
tests.when: POST /api/v1/workspaces/<slug>/branches/fix/push with no body
then: the status is 200
body.branch is fix, body.sha is the 40-hex tip of refs/heads/fix in the trunk, body.remote is origin
body.result is pushed
the bare origin now has refs/heads/fix at body.sha
tests.pseudocode: r = env.doRequest(POST, '/api/v1/workspaces/'+slug+'/branches/fix/push', nil, userAuth); assert r.code==200; assert r.json.sha==trunkTip('fix'); assert bare.rev('refs/heads/fix')==r.json.sha

tests.title: Any valid branch name sent as one escaped segment is decoded exactly once
given: an active, ready workspace whose trunk holds the generated branch and a local bare origin
tests.when: for any valid branch name (including names with '/', '%25' sequences and literal '%' characters), the name is escaped with url.PathEscape-style %2F encoding and posted
then: body.branch equals the original name
the ref pushed to origin is refs/heads/<original name>
fix%2F42-nil-map names fix/42-nil-map and a%2525b names a%25b, never a%b
tests.pseudocode: for name in genValidBranchNames(): seed(trunk, name); r=post(escapeSegment(name)); assert r.json.branch==name; assert bare.has('refs/heads/'+name)

tests.title: An unescaped slash inside the branch name matches no route and sends nothing
given: an active, ready workspace with branch fix/x in the trunk
an audit emitter capturing events
tests.when: POST /api/v1/workspaces/<slug>/branches/fix/x/push is sent with a literal slash
then: the status is 404 from the router
no hub.branch.push event is emitted
origin received nothing
tests.pseudocode: r=post('/branches/fix/x/push'); assert r.code==404; assert events.count('hub.branch.push')==0; assert bare.refs()==[]

tests.title: An empty body, a body without force and a body with unknown fields all push non-forced
given: an active, ready workspace with branch fix in the trunk
a stub push seam or local bare origin recording the refspec
tests.when: the route is called with an empty body, with {}, and with {"colour":"red"}
then: each call answers 200
the refspec used is refs/heads/fix:refs/heads/fix without a leading +
tests.pseudocode: for body in ['', '{}', '{"colour":"red"}']: r=post(body); assert r.code==200; assert recordedRefspec=='refs/heads/fix:refs/heads/fix'

tests.title: A malformed body, a non-object body or a non-boolean force is rejected with 400 before the lock
given: an active, ready workspace
the workspace lock is observable
an audit emitter capturing events
tests.when: the route is called with `{bad`, with `[1]`, with {"force":"yes"} and with {"force":1}
then: each answer is 400 with apikit's error envelope
the lock is never taken (TryLock succeeds afterwards and no trunk read happened)
no push is attempted and no audit event is emitted
tests.pseudocode: for b in bodies: r=post(b); assert r.code==400; assert r.json.error!=''; assert events.count==0; assert not pushCalled

tests.title: result is pushed, then up_to_date on repeat, up_to_date even with force, and forced when force overwrote the forge
given: an active, ready standard workspace with branch feat and a local bare origin
a second branch other whose origin tip diverges from the trunk's
tests.when: feat is pushed, pushed again, pushed again with force true; then other is pushed with force true after origin diverged
then: first answer result is pushed
second answer result is up_to_date and no objects were sent
third answer result is up_to_date despite force
the forced push of other answers result forced and origin's other equals the trunk's tip
tests.pseudocode: assert push('feat').result=='pushed'; assert push('feat').result=='up_to_date'; assert push('feat',force=true).result=='up_to_date'; diverge(bare,'other'); assert push('other',force=true).result=='forced'

tests.title: remote_url has userinfo stripped for scheme URLs and is unchanged for scp-style addresses
given: workspaces seeded with git_url http://user:secret@127.0.0.1:PORT/r.git and git@github.com:acme/widgets.git
a push seam that returns success
tests.when: the route is called for each workspace
then: the first answer's remote_url is http://127.0.0.1:PORT/r.git and contains no user:secret@
the second answer's remote_url is git@github.com:acme/widgets.git
tests.pseudocode: assert r1.json.remote_url=='http://127.0.0.1:PORT/r.git'; assert r2.json.remote_url=='git@github.com:acme/widgets.git'

tests.title: Own error types carry their type as a message prefix while shared answers keep shared messages
given: workspaces covering missing branch, integration branch, patch branch, protected branch, non-fast-forward and a forge failure
a busy workspace, an unknown slug, an org member and a PAT without scope
tests.when: each refusal is triggered
then: messages for branch_not_found, integration_branch, patch_branch, protected_branch, non_fast_forward and forge_* start with '<error_type>: '

the 404 is exactly 'workspace not found', the org-member 403 is 'org members have read-only access to this workspace', the scope 403 is 'PAT requires workspaces:write scope to push branches', the busy 409 is 'another operation is running on this workspace; retry later'
tests.pseudocode: for (case,type) in own: assert startsWith(r.json.error, type+': '); for shared: assert r.json.error==sharedText

tests.title: A request with no credential is refused with 401
given: an active, ready workspace
an audit emitter capturing events
tests.when: the route is called without an Authorization header
then: the status is 401
no push is attempted and no hub.branch.push event is emitted
tests.pseudocode: r=post(noAuth); assert r.code==401; assert events.count==0

tests.title: A PAT bound to another workspace gets 404 workspace not found before the scope check
given: a real hub with workspaces A and B owned by the same user
a PAT bound to A with scopes workspaces:write, and another bound to A without scopes
tests.when: each PAT calls the push route on B's slug
then: both answers are 404 with message 'workspace not found'
no hub.branch.push event is emitted and nothing reaches B's origin
tests.pseudocode: for pat in [boundWithScope, boundWithoutScope]: r=post(B, pat); assert r.code==404; assert r.json.error=='workspace not found'

tests.title: An unbound PAT without workspaces:write gets 403 with the scope message and no error_type, even for an unknown slug
given: an owner's PAT with only workspaces:read
an existing workspace and an unknown slug
tests.when: the PAT calls the push route on both slugs
then: both answers are 403 with message 'PAT requires workspaces:write scope to push branches'
the envelope has no error_type
no workspace lookup precedes the refusal and no event is emitted
tests.pseudocode: for slug in [existing,'nope']: r=post(slug, pat); assert r.code==403; assert r.json.error_type==''

tests.title: An unknown slug or a stranger gets 404 workspace not found
given: a workspace owned by user A
user B is not an admin and not a member of A's org
tests.when: B calls the route on A's slug and A calls it on an unknown slug
then: both answers are 404 with message 'workspace not found'
no hub.branch.push event is emitted
tests.pseudocode: assert post(slugA, userB).code==404; assert post('nope', userA).json.error=='workspace not found'

tests.title: An org member who is not the owner gets 403 forbidden
given: an org workspace owned by user A
user M is a member of the org
tests.when: M calls the push route using an API key and a PAT with workspaces:write
then: both answers are 403 with error_type forbidden and message 'org members have read-only access to this workspace'
no event is emitted and nothing is pushed
tests.pseudocode: r=post(slug, userM); assert r.code==403; assert r.json.error_type=='forbidden'

tests.title: A database failure during the workspace lookup answers 500 with no event
given: a handler whose database connection has been closed
tests.when: the owner calls the push route
then: the status is 500
no hub.branch.push event is emitted and nothing is pushed
tests.pseudocode: env.db.Close(); r=post(...); assert r.code==500; assert events.count==0

tests.title: The owner with an API key, the owner with a scoped PAT, a PAT bound to this slug and an admin token all get past access
given: an active, ready workspace with branch fix and a local bare origin
a real hub for the bound PAT
tests.when: each of the four callers pushes fix
then: none of the answers is 401, 403 or 404 workspace not found
each answer is 200
tests.pseudocode: for auth in [apiKey, patWrite, boundPatWrite, admin]: assert post(auth).code==200

tests.title: A malformed branch name answers 404 branch_not_found naming the broken rule, whether or not the lock is held
given: an active, ready workspace
a second run with the workspace lock held by another operation
tests.when: the route is called with -x, a name containing '..', a name ending in '.lock' and a name with a space
then: each answer is 404 with error_type branch_not_found
the message starts with 'branch_not_found: ' and for -x reads 'branch_not_found: "-x" is not a valid branch name: ref name must not start with '-''
the answer is the same with the lock held (never 409)
no event is emitted
tests.pseudocode: for n in bad: r=post(esc(n)); assert r.code==404; assert r.json.error_type=='branch_not_found'; hold lock; assert post(esc(n)).code==404

tests.title: An inactive workspace or one whose clone is not ready is refused with 400 before the lock
given: a workspace with status archived
a workspace with status active and clone_status cloning
an audit emitter capturing events
tests.when: the owner pushes a branch on each workspace
then: the first answer is 400 with message 'workspace is not active; push requires an active workspace'
the second answer is 400 with message 'workspace clone is not ready; clone_status must be 'ready' to push'
the lock was not taken and no event is emitted
tests.pseudocode: assert post(archived).json.error=='workspace is not active; push requires an active workspace'; assert post(cloning).code==400

tests.title: On a carry_patch workspace the integration branch (column value or default deploy) is refused with 400 integration_branch
given: a carry_patch workspace with integration_branch NULL and another with integration_branch 'stage'
branches deploy and stage exist in the trunk
a push seam that fails the test if called
tests.when: the owner pushes deploy on the first workspace and stage on the second, with the workspace lock held by another operation
then: both answers are 400 with error_type integration_branch (not 409, so the decision precedes the lock)
messages mention that hub builds the branch and REBUILD_PUSH_INTEGRATION_BRANCH
nothing is sent to the forge and no event is emitted
tests.pseudocode: assert post('deploy').json.error_type=='integration_branch'; assert contains(msg,'REBUILD_PUSH_INTEGRATION_BRANCH'); assert not pushCalled

tests.title: A registered patch branch is refused with patch_branch while an unregistered or deleted-patch branch pushes normally
given: a carry_patch workspace with patch rows: p1 status active, p2 status deleted
branches p1, p2 and free exist in the trunk
a local bare origin
tests.when: the owner pushes p1, p2 and free
then: p1 answers 400 patch_branch with a message pointing to PUSH_PATCHES_TO_ORIGIN and nothing reaches origin
p2 answers 200 pushed
free answers 200 pushed, the same as on a standard workspace
tests.pseudocode: assert post('p1').json.error_type=='patch_branch'; assert post('p2').code==200; assert post('free').code==200

tests.title: force on the workspace's own branch is refused 400 protected_branch in both modes, while a non-forced push of it is a fast-forward push
given: a standard and a carry_patch workspace, each with the branch column set to main and branch main in the trunk
a local bare origin
tests.when: the owner pushes main with force true, with the lock held, and then without force
then: the forced push answers 400 protected_branch before the lock (even with the lock held) and nothing reaches origin, no event
the unforced push answers 200 pushed on both workspaces
tests.pseudocode: assert post('main',{force:true}).json.error_type=='protected_branch'; assert post('main',{force:false}).json.result=='pushed'

tests.title: With a null branch column, force on the HEAD branch is refused under the lock; an unreadable HEAD answers 500; the lock is released
given: a workspace with branch NULL whose trunk HEAD is main
a second workspace whose trunk HEAD cannot be read (HEAD file corrupted)
an audit emitter
tests.when: the owner pushes main with force true on the first workspace and any branch with force true on the second
then: the first answer is 400 protected_branch and nothing is pushed
the second answer is 500 and nothing is pushed
TryLock succeeds on both slugs afterwards and no event is emitted
tests.pseudocode: assert post(ws1,'main',force).json.error_type=='protected_branch'; assert post(ws2,'x',force).code==500; assert tryLock(ws1).ok

tests.title: A database failure while deciding integration, patch or protected branch answers 500 without contacting the forge
given: a carry_patch workspace row loaded, then the patches table dropped so the patch lookup fails
a push seam that fails the test if called
tests.when: the owner pushes an ordinary branch
then: the status is 500
the push seam was not called and no event is emitted
tests.pseudocode: db.Exec('DROP TABLE patches'); r=post('x'); assert r.code==500; assert not pushCalled

tests.title: A held workspace lock answers 409 workspace_busy immediately with no event
given: the workspace lock is held by another operation (also: a rebuild in its fetch phase)
an audit emitter
tests.when: the owner pushes an existing branch
then: the status is 409 with error_type workspace_busy and message 'another operation is running on this workspace; retry later'
the answer comes without waiting
no push attempt and no event
tests.pseudocode: unlock=wslock.TryLock(slug); r=post(); assert r.code==409; assert r.json.error_type=='workspace_busy'; assert elapsed<1s

tests.title: A rebuild between its fetch and final phases does not block the push
given: a carry_patch workspace with a rebuild job running but not holding the workspace lock
a local bare origin and branch feat in the trunk
tests.when: the owner pushes feat
then: the answer is 200 pushed, not 409 workspace_busy
tests.pseudocode: startRebuildBetweenPhases(slug); assert post('feat').code==200

tests.title: A valid name missing from the trunk answers 404 branch_not_found and releases the lock
given: an active, ready workspace whose trunk has no branch ghost
an audit emitter
tests.when: the owner pushes ghost
then: the status is 404 with error_type branch_not_found and message 'branch_not_found: branch "ghost" does not exist in the workspace'
no event is emitted
TryLock succeeds afterwards
tests.pseudocode: r=post('ghost'); assert r.json.error=='branch_not_found: branch "ghost" does not exist in the workspace'; assert tryLock(slug).ok

tests.title: sha is the trunk tip read under the lock and the lock is released after every outcome
given: a workspace with branch feat in the trunk and a local bare origin
a push seam variant that blocks until released, and variants that fail, or time out
tests.when: the push is run to success, to failure, and with the caller disconnected mid-push
then: body.sha and the event's sha equal the trunk tip of refs/heads/feat
while the push is in flight a concurrent TryLock fails
after each outcome (including a disconnected caller once the push ends) TryLock succeeds
tests.pseudocode: assert r.json.sha==tip; during block: assert not tryLock; release; assert tryLock(slug).ok

tests.title: When HEAD moved during the lock, the worktree is hard-reset to the new HEAD commit
given: a workspace with trunk HEAD on main and a clean worktree
a hook during the push that advances refs/heads/main as receive-pack would (without touching the worktree)
tests.when: the owner pushes another branch and HEAD resolves to a new commit before release
then: the answer is unchanged (200)
the trunk worktree files equal the new HEAD commit and git status is clean
tests.pseudocode: hook: updateRef(main,newCommit); r=post('feat'); assert r.code==200; assert worktreeMatches(newCommit)

tests.title: A failed reset, an unmoved HEAD or an unreadable HEAD leaves the answer unchanged and logs at most one warning
given: a workspace where the worktree reset is made to fail
a workspace where HEAD does not move
a workspace whose HEAD is unreadable at lock time (non-forced push)
a captured log
tests.when: the owner pushes a branch in each case
then: each answer is the push's own answer (200)
the failed reset logs exactly one warning with no secret
the other two cases leave the worktree untouched and log no reset warning
tests.pseudocode: assert r.code==200; assert logs.count('warn','reset')==1 for failing case; assert worktreeUntouched for others

tests.title: The push sends exactly the one refspec (plus form when forced) to origin at git_url with the stored credential
given: an HTTP stand-in forge (git http-backend over a recording proxy) that records requests and ref updates
workspaces with GIT_PAT, with GIT_USERNAME/GIT_PASSWORD, with both, and with none
tests.when: the owner pushes feat and, on another run, pushes feat with force true
then: the forge receives a ref update only for refs/heads/feat
the recorded refspec is refs/heads/feat:refs/heads/feat, and +refs/heads/feat:refs/heads/feat when forced
the Basic credential is x-token-auth:<pat> when GIT_PAT is set (even if username/password exist), user:password when only those exist, and absent when none
tests.pseudocode: assert forge.updatedRefs==['refs/heads/feat']; assert forge.authHeader==basic('x-token-auth',pat)

tests.title: A secrets-store failure answers 500 internal server error without contacting the forge and without logging secrets
given: a workspace whose secrets table is unavailable
a captured log and audit emitter
tests.when: the owner pushes an existing branch
then: the status is 500 with message 'internal server error'
no push was attempted, no hub.branch.push event
the log contains no secret
tests.pseudocode: db.Exec('DROP TABLE secrets'); r=post(); assert r.code==500; assert r.json.error=='internal server error'; assert not pushCalled

tests.title: A stalled forge yields 504 forge_timeout at the two-minute deadline, and a disconnect does not cancel the push
given: a stand-in forge that stalls (clock injectable or deadline observable on the context)
a second forge that answers after a delay while the client request context is cancelled
tests.when: the owner pushes with the stalled forge; then the caller disconnects mid-push against the slow forge
then: the push context carries a deadline of two minutes from push start and the answer is 504 with error_type forge_timeout
after the disconnect the push still completes at the forge and the lock remains held until it ends
the outcome is logged and audited as if the caller were connected
tests.pseudocode: assert ctxDeadline-start==2min; cancel(reqCtx); wait; assert forge.hasRef('feat'); assert events.count==1

tests.title: A non-fast-forward push answers 409 non_fast_forward with origin's commit and the right hint, or without commit when listing fails
given: origin's feat has a commit the trunk lacks
origin's own-branch main has a commit the trunk lacks
a variant where the origin listing fails after the refusal
a counter of ls-refs calls
tests.when: the owner pushes feat, then main (branch column main), then feat with the listing failing
then: each answer is 409 with error_type non_fast_forward
feat message is 'non_fast_forward: origin's feat is at <sha>, which is not in the workspace's branch; push with force to overwrite it'
main message ends with a hint to sync the workspace, not a force hint
the listing-failure message omits the commit
origin's refs are listed exactly once per refusal; origin is unchanged
tests.pseudocode: assert r.code==409; assert contains(r.json.error, originSha); assert endsWith(r.json.error,'push with force to overwrite it'); assert lsRefsCount==1

tests.title: Forge 401 maps to 502 forge_unauthenticated naming the credential kind; 403 maps to 502 forge_forbidden
given: an HTTP stand-in forge answering 401, then 403
workspaces with GIT_PAT, with GIT_USERNAME/GIT_PASSWORD, and with no credential
tests.when: the owner pushes against each combination
then: 401 answers are 502 forge_unauthenticated; the message says no stored credential exists, or that the forge rejected GIT_PAT or GIT_USERNAME/GIT_PASSWORD
403 answers are 502 forge_forbidden
no message contains the credential value
tests.pseudocode: assert r.code==502; assert r.json.error_type=='forge_unauthenticated'; assert contains(msg,'GIT_PAT'); assert not contains(msg,pat)

tests.title: Repository-not-found maps to 404 forge_not_found and a refused ref maps to 422 forge_rejected with the scrubbed reason
given: an HTTP stand-in forge answering repository not found
a local bare origin with a pre-receive hook declining the ref with a reason containing a secret-like URL user:pw@host
tests.when: the owner pushes feat to each
then: first answer is 404 with error_type forge_not_found
second answer is 422 with error_type forge_rejected and a message carrying the forge's reason with userinfo removed
tests.pseudocode: assert r1.code==404; assert r2.code==422; assert contains(r2.msg,'declined'); assert not contains(r2.msg,'user:pw@')

tests.title: DNS/TCP/TLS failures map to 502 forge_unreachable and other failures to 502 forge_error
given: a workspace with git_url on an unresolvable host or a closed port
a workspace whose forge answers a malformed protocol response
tests.when: the owner pushes feat to each
then: the first answer is 502 with error_type forge_unreachable
the second answer is 502 with error_type forge_error
both are push attempts: one event each
tests.pseudocode: assert r1.json.error_type=='forge_unreachable'; assert r2.json.error_type=='forge_error'

tests.title: A trunk that cannot be opened or has no origin answers 500 with no event and no push-attempt warning
given: a workspace whose trunk directory is missing
a workspace whose trunk is a repository with no origin remote
a captured log and audit emitter
tests.when: the owner pushes a branch on each
then: both answers are 500
no hub.branch.push event
no push-attempt warning record with an error_type field
the lock is released
tests.pseudocode: assert r.code==500; assert events.count==0; assert logs.where(error_type).count==0

tests.title: The scrub removes the secret and userinfo, is idempotent, valid UTF-8 and at most 1024 bytes
given: the local scrub function of internal/workspace
tests.when: for any text (including nested or split occurrences, multi-byte runes and long input) and any non-empty secret
then: the output does not contain the secret
the output contains no scheme://userinfo@ segment
the output is valid UTF-8 and at most 1024 bytes
scrub(scrub(x)) equals scrub(x)
tests.pseudocode: for (text,secret) in gen(): o=scrub(text,secret); assert !contains(o,secret); assert !userinfoRE.match(o); assert utf8.Valid(o); assert len(o)<=1024; assert scrub(o,secret)==o

tests.title: No response, audit event or log line contains the credential secret or the git_url userinfo
given: a workspace with git_url http://u:urlpw@127.0.0.1:PORT/r.git and GIT_PAT 'tok-12345'
forge stand-ins whose error text echoes the URL and the token
captured responses, events and logs
tests.when: the owner pushes through success, 401, 403, rejection, non-fast-forward and unreachable outcomes
then: no response body, event metadata or log line contains tok-12345 or urlpw
the response does not carry go-git's full error chain
tests.pseudocode: for o in outcomes: run(o); for s in [responses,events,logs]: assert not contains(s,'tok-12345') and not contains(s,'urlpw')

tests.title: Each failed push attempt logs exactly one warning with workspace, branch, error_type and the scrubbed error; success logs none
given: a captured structured log
forge outcomes: success, up_to_date, non_fast_forward, forge_rejected, forge_timeout
tests.when: the owner pushes under each outcome
then: each failing outcome produces exactly one warning record with fields workspace, branch, error_type and error
success and up_to_date produce no warning under this rule
tests.pseudocode: assert logs.warn.count==1; assert logs.warn[0].fields>=['workspace','branch','error_type','error']

tests.title: A 500 answer is logged as an internal error with the credential and userinfo scrubbed
given: a workspace with GIT_PAT 'tok-12345' and git_url with userinfo
a trunk that cannot be opened with an error text echoing the URL
tests.when: the owner pushes and the route answers 500
then: an internal-error log line exists
it contains neither tok-12345 nor the userinfo
tests.pseudocode: assert r.code==500; assert logs.any('internal'); assert not contains(logs,'tok-12345')

tests.title: The audit package defines EventBranchPush as hub.branch.push
given: the audit package
tests.when: audit.EventBranchPush is read
then: its value is the string hub.branch.push
tests.pseudocode: assert audit.EventBranchPush=='hub.branch.push'

tests.title: Every push attempt outcome emits exactly one hub.branch.push event with the right identity fields, also on the SSE stream
given: a capturing audit emitter wired to the SSE broadcaster
forge outcomes pushed, forced, up_to_date, non_fast_forward, forge_not_found, forge_rejected, forge_unauthenticated, forge_forbidden, forge_unreachable, forge_error and forge_timeout
tests.when: the owner pushes under each outcome
then: exactly one event per request with EventType hub.branch.push, ResourceType branch, ResourceID the branch name, Action push, Workspace the slug
the actor is the caller's
the event is received by an SSE subscriber
tests.pseudocode: for o in outcomes: run(o); assert events.count==1; e=events[0]; assert e.ResourceType=='branch' and e.Action=='push' and e.Workspace==slug

tests.title: The event metadata has branch, sha, force, ok, remote, remote_url and exactly one of result or error_type, never secrets or forge text
given: a success and a failed push (forge_rejected with message text containing a secret) with forced and unforced requests
userinfo in git_url
tests.when: events are inspected
then: both carry branch, sha (40-hex), force, ok, remote 'origin' and remote_url without userinfo
the success has result and no error_type; the failure has error_type and no result
no metadata value contains the credential or the forge's message text
tests.pseudocode: assert keys(m)>={'branch','sha','force','ok','remote','remote_url'}; assert ('result' in m) != ('error_type' in m)

tests.title: Refusals and hub-internal failures emit no hub.branch.push event
given: a capturing emitter

cases: 401, scope 403, org-member 403, 404 workspace not found, 404 branch_not_found (invalid and missing), 400 (body, inactive, clone not ready, integration, patch, protected), 409 workspace_busy, 500 (secrets failure, trunk cannot be opened, no origin)
tests.when: each case is requested
then: the expected status is returned for each
zero hub.branch.push events were emitted across all cases
tests.pseudocode: for c in cases: assert post(c).code==c.status; assert events.count('hub.branch.push')==0

tests.title: When the caller disconnects mid-push the event is still emitted once with the real outcome
given: a slow stand-in forge that accepts the push after the request context is cancelled
a variant where the forge refuses after the cancel
tests.when: the request context is cancelled during the push and the push ends
then: exactly one event is emitted per variant
the first has ok true and result pushed, the second ok false and the matching error_type
the event was emitted with a context that is not cancelled
tests.pseudocode: cancel(reqCtx); waitForPushEnd(); assert events.count==1; assert events[0].Metadata.ok==true

tests.title: afc workspace push sends the escaped path and {force:bool} and warns on stderr only with --force
given: an httptest stub hub recording r.URL.EscapedPath() and the body
tests.when: `afc workspace push ws fix/42-nil-map` and `afc workspace push ws fix/42-nil-map --force` run
then: the escaped path is /api/v1/workspaces/ws/branches/fix%2F42-nil-map/push for both
bodies are {"force":false} and {"force":true}
stderr has no warning without --force and exactly one warning line mentioning origin's branch may be overwritten with --force, written before the request is sent
tests.pseudocode: assert hub.path=='/api/v1/workspaces/ws/branches/fix%2F42-nil-map/push'; assert hub.body.force==true; assert count(lines(stderr))==1

tests.title: On a 200 answer afc prints the response as one JSON document and exits 0
given: a stub hub answering 200 with the push response body
tests.when: `afc workspace push ws feat` runs
then: stdout is exactly one JSON document equal to the response
the exit code is 0
tests.pseudocode: out=run(); assert json.valid(out); assert one document; assert exit==0

tests.title: On a hub error afc prints the error envelope and exits 1, with non_fast_forward visible
given: a stub hub answering 409 with message 'non_fast_forward: origin's feat is at abc…' and error_type non_fast_forward
tests.when: `afc workspace push ws feat` runs
then: the output contains the hub code 409 and the message including non_fast_forward
